# Notice-local requirements contract

The active schemas in `resources/schemas/rendering.json` and `resources/typst/report.json` own this contract. One Typst evaluator produces requirements/content findings in native and Studio; Core prepares trusted facts, validates evidence, retains artifacts and routes. No YAML compatibility, fallback or extra compilation. W1 `subjects` on link findings remains independent.

## Versions, fields, lifecycle

Bump preparation envelope 1→2, payload 1→2 (`urn:immuknow:rendering:2`), placed report 2→3 (`urn:immuknow:render-report:3`); update shared identities, Typst check-notice, generated Studio types/validators and examples together. Saved-run schema need not bump solely for this; old saved observations remain rebundleable, never silently reevaluated under edited notices.

Core prepares `notice.forecast_coverage`: `{missing_diseases: string[], extra_diseases: string[], unmapped_agents: string[]}`. Each list sorted unique; disease names normalized, agents exact; data derives from complete input and references before display exclusions. Report `notice` must equal this prepared payload. No independent JS forecast evaluator. `prepare` puts `["notice.requirements","notice.eligibility","data.forecast_coverage","content.agent_display"]` in entry `deferred_checks` outside `checks`. Deferred means unchecked, not warning/pass; browser shows neutral advisory and does not increase warning count. A validated report (valid or failed-declaration branch) resolves and clears deferred; save final observed checks and `blocked_checks`. Compilation failure or corrupt outer evidence leaves deferred/unverified diagnostics, adds mandatory `rendering.failed` or `render.evidence_failed` respectively, and cannot route deliverable. Current preview identity/currentness governs advisory replacement. Reb‌undle uses saved checks/blocked state, no recompilation.

## Placed declaration API and report branches

Use `#immuknow.requirements(eligibility: "...", coverage: "...")`; settings binds shared `requirements(notice, ...)` to prepared notice. Place exactly one active call as content; neutral is explicit `(eligibility: "any", coverage: "neutral")`. Declaration carries exact `row_key`, `client_id`, `template`, `version_id`, `language` from notice and `eligibility`/`coverage`. Allowed eligibility `any|has_overdue|has_overdue_agents|no_overdue|has_ispa_overdue`; coverage `agents|diseases|neutral`. Conditional templates place only active branch. Query placed metadata at final report, never source text. Outer report preserves identity/source association.

Report `requirements` is a tagged union, never arbitrary raw Typst values as trusted content:

- valid: `{state:"valid", declaration:{row_key,client_id,template,version_id,language,eligibility,coverage}}`.
- invalid: `{state:"invalid", errors:[{code:"missing"|"duplicate"|"malformed"|"unknown_value", count: integer}]}`. Values are sanitized diagnostics only; arbitrary malformed raw values are not copied to authoritative fields. All duplicate declarations, identical or differing, use `duplicate` with count >= 2. Missing/unplaced call is missing. Preserve safe ordinary findings.

Exactly one nonadjustable check `notice.requirements` stage render, status `pass|fail`, no component/page: valid branch → pass; invalid branch → fail plus `blocked_checks` exactly `[ {code:"notice.eligibility",blocked_by:"notice.requirements",reason:"Invalid notice requirements"}, {code:"data.forecast_coverage",blocked_by:"notice.requirements",reason:"Invalid notice requirements"}, {code:"content.agent_display",blocked_by:"notice.requirements",reason:"Invalid notice requirements"} ]` in this order. Invalid branch has no observed dependent checks; it is not not_applicable/pass. It is a complete validated report and clears deferred. The failed mandatory requirement routes a readable PDF to review.

Valid branch has `blocked_checks: []` and exactly one observed check of each dependent code. Required per-code statuses: `notice.eligibility: pass|fail|not_applicable`; `data.forecast_coverage: pass|warn|fail|not_applicable`; `content.agent_display: pass|fail|not_applicable`. All stage render, nonadjustable, and no `not_run`; constrain each code in exported schema, not generic status alone. `content.agent_display` is a report-level finding (`x-components: []`, no `component` or `page`) because neutral/absent component is legitimately N/A; any linked placed agent evidence separately requires its page (1..page_count) and identity. Eligibility/coverage checks are also report-level, no page/component. The validator enforces branches and cardinality, check identity/shape and component consistency, without a second clinical/content evaluator.

Corrupt outer report, payload/report notice mismatch, wrong outer/declaration/component source identity, missing required valid-branch result, invalid check cardinality/status, inconsistent blocked structure or dishonest summary/component association fails native and browser evidence validation with `render.evidence_failed`. The coordinator writes a readable original before validating, retains it for review and rejects claims from that corrupt report. A fundamental Typst assertion/compile error has no PDF, remains report-only. Wrong-row declaration is corrupt evidence, not a sanitized malformed declaration; recognize identity before trusting any declaration or blocked result. A malformed identity cannot assert association and is corrupt; a structurally malformed non-identity declaration with verifiable source provenance produces the invalid branch. No arbitrary invalid raw payload is authoritative.

## Rule outcomes

Eligibility: `any`→not_applicable; `has_overdue` is nonempty `notice.overdue_diseases`; `has_overdue_agents` is nonempty `notice.overdue_agents`; `no_overdue` is empty diseases; `has_ispa_overdue` uses existing `ispa-overdue-diseases` selection and cohort/date logic. All other eligibility outcomes pass/fail; no new clinical assessment. Existing ISPA invalid date assertions remain fundamental errors.

Coverage `neutral`→not_applicable. For `agents`/`diseases`, no source diseases and agents→not_applicable; otherwise missing→fail for agents or warn for diseases; no missing but extra/unmapped→warn; otherwise pass. Preserve all missing/extra/unmapped measurements even when several conditions overlap; `data.forecast_coverage.measurements` exactly equals `notice.forecast_coverage`. Notice source eligibility/version-conflict safeguards stay separate; delete only catalog-derived checks.

For exactly one placed `overdue_agents` or alternative, component measurements have `page` (1-based), `row_key`, `client_id`, `source_matches`, `source_agents` (exact input sequence including duplicates), `source_count` (sequence length), `excluded_agents` (sorted unique input agent names matching exclusion config even when no-records replaces list), `displayed_agents` (exact first-occurrence sequence after filtering/dedup when replacement=none, otherwise []), `displayed_count` (length), `replacement: "none"|"no_records"|"authored_alternative"`, `replacement_visible` (false for none, true only when a replacement has visible content). Nonempty source plus all excluded and no replacement fails agent display, shown or intentional replacement passes; empty source without replacement→not_applicable (eligibility separate). Disease/neutral→not_applicable. For agent basis require exactly one placed agent component or intentional alternative; absence, duplicates, inconsistent counts/lists/identity/page are corrupt evidence (`render.evidence_failed`), not fabricated success. Both source nonempty and no records replacement may legitimately give displayed count 0; exclusions describe what would be excluded irrespective of replacement.

`overdue-agents(no-records: auto|content|none)` selects replacement only if no records and argument is not none. Custom `no-records` and `agent-alternative(notice, body)` must contain non-whitespace textual content or a non-text visible content node; empty content, whitespace-only text and metadata-only content produce mandatory component/evidence failure while retaining the readable PDF; do not assert and abort compilation. A narrow syntactic visible-content predicate is sufficient; do not attempt semantic text approval. Alternative uses `#immuknow.agent-alternative[body]`, bound by settings; emits placed identity-bound agent evidence with replacement authored_alternative, zero displayed, exactly one component. Duplicate component/alternative is rejected. Place evidence using final page location; excluded agents for alternative are [] unless explicit exclusions are passed to its API (default []); author-defined body must not claim a displayed list.

## Maintained notice table

| Template | Eligibility | Coverage | Display branch |
|---|---|---|---|
| overdue_agents.en/fr | has_overdue_agents | agents | `no-records:auto`; otherwise exact exclusions/dedup |
| overdue_diseases.en/fr | has_overdue | diseases | `no-records:auto`; no agent display |
| affirmative_schedule.en | no_overdue | neutral | no overdue component; replace eligibility assertion with finding |
| suspension_order.en | has_ispa_overdue | diseases | `ispa-only:true`, `no-records:none`; replace eligibility assertion, retain ISPA/date assertions |

Six actual files; no French affirmative/suspension assumed. No-records branch does not manufacture missing source eligibility. Existing Typst metadata output must remain usable for missing/duplicate/malformed requirements; do not assert and lose PDF merely because declaration invalid.

## Fixture format and validation

`requirements-contract.json` contains complete fictional payloads and reports, plus preparation/final expectations. `expect.evidence_valid` is checked by the native and browser validators. `expect.observations` lists the required findings; ordinary fixture checks remain intact. `expect.routing` presumes a readable original unless stated. Compiler tests verify the shared evaluator's outcomes, placed declarations and no-records/alternative evidence. Native integration tests verify deferred → valid/blocked/unverified lifecycle, review artifact retention and saved-observation rebundling. These checks use the active schemas directly; there are no separate schema copies to maintain.
